The 8080 state lists 50 of the 53 active 8080 students (scoped by school_id, cap 50); its tiles 47/3/3 are computed from those rows. Default state spans schools 8090 (28), 8277 (11), 8080 (4), 8107 (4), 8228 (2), 8880 (1). ALESA Ketepatan equals the prediction-row accuracy; the grade is not an accuracy band (C at 30%, D at 28%, E at 0%).
